bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "ebf9e0897afe94a02e61263df3b7109f4e48c34b"
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request,hashlib,subprocess
for c in ("debug-ai-debug-ai-1","debug-ai-sandbox-runner-1"):
 for path in ("server/workflow.js","server/adapters/ai-core.js"):
  a=hashlib.sha256(open(path,"rb").read()).hexdigest()
  b=subprocess.check_output(["docker","exec",c,"node","-e",'const fs=require("node:fs"),c=require("node:crypto");console.log(c.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest("hex"))',"/app/"+path],text=True).strip()
  assert a==b,(c,path)
base="http://127.0.0.1:8787"
assert urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/health",timeout=5).status==200
old=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/realdebug_2f5bdaf39b7e448d8cc53a0cbb81534d",timeout=5))
assert not old["active_in_process"]
r=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/v1/status/run_mwytb5d9_cf1d2b2ecd",timeout=5))["durable"]
assert not r["active_in_process"] and r["job_status"] in ("DONE","BLOCKED","FAILED","CANCELLED"),"PREVIOUS_TEST_NOT_TERMINAL"
print("OLD_TEST",json.dumps({"state":old["state"],"interrupted":old.get("interrupted"),"run_status":r["job_status"],"error":r.get("last_execution_error")}),flush=True)
corpus=json.load(open("scripts/real-debug-corpus.json"))
assert len(corpus["cases"])==50 and all(sum(c["level"]==l for c in corpus["cases"])==10 for l in range(1,6))
req=urllib.request.Request(base+"/v1/investigation-benchmark/start",data=json.dumps({"suite":"real-debug","case_ids":[c["id"] for c in corpus["cases"]]}).encode(),headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15) as resp:
 result=json.load(resp);print("FRESH_START_HTTP",resp.status,json.dumps(result),flush=True)
 assert resp.status==202 and result["corpus_digest"]==old["corpus_digest"] and result["total"]==50 and result["state"]=="RUNNING"
s=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen(base+"/v1/investigation-benchmark/status/"+result["benchmark_id"],timeout=5))
assert s["case_ids"]==[c["id"] for c in corpus["cases"]] and s["summary"]["total"]==50
print("FIFTY_CASE_READBACK",json.dumps({k:s[k] for k in ("benchmark_id","state","current","summary","active_in_process")}),flush=True)
PY
